data.long_meaning: In the Yoruba language, Femi is derived from the word ‘fe mi’, which means ‘I will promise’. It is a name given to a child as a symbol of hope and a reminder of God’s promises. The name Femi is also associated with the concept of treasure or wealth. The name Femi carries the meaning “Promise, Treasure” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Femi usually hope their child will grow to embody promise, treasure and live with faith, good character and purpose.
